body.name: British Columbia Trade Development Corporation
body.notes: The British Columbia Trade Development Corporation, BC Trade, set up in 1989 to help B.C. businesses sell abroad, with market research, overseas business contacts and export financing. Its maple leaf, flag and rising sun, rebuilt from the colour back cover of a 1991 directory it co-published, and seen in black in its July 1989 launch advertisement. Its functions passed to the British Columbia Trade and Investment Office in March 1996; the corporation was wound up and dissolved in November 2003.

bodyNote: BC Trade was not among the bodies the 2026-10-22 acquisition inventory searched; this record adds it, with the inventory's fields, so the gallery has a body to file its logo under.
summary: A manual vector reconstruction of the British Columbia Trade Development Corporation (BC Trade) logo: a red maple leaf over a waving flag of red and blue bands with a rising gold sun, above “BC TRADE” in heavy italic serif capitals. Revised on 2026-11-14 against the colour back cover of British Columbia: Software Developers 1991, with the open letter separations corroborated by the 1989 newspaper example. The flag follow-up uses fixed-registration overlays to refine fold joins and blue tips. See package-README.md, validation.json, review/comparison.webp and review/flag-overlay.html. The softer scan-tones palette and symbol-only output are reconstruction adaptations, not documented historical variants, and are not used as separate gallery marks.

assets.label: BC Trade: Maple leaf, flag and rising sun
assets.sourceLocator: Rebuilt after the back cover of British Columbia: Software Developers 1991 (PDF page 146); page 145 names BC Trade and Industry, Science and Technology Canada as its publishers
assets.dateNote: The 1991 directory is the colour source. The same mark, in black, closes BC Trade’s launch advertisement (“Going the distance for B.C. business”) in the Gulf Islands Driftwood of 12 July 1989, printed page A19: documented use by that date, not its first. The corporation was established by the Trade Development Corporation Act, assented to 1 June 1989; the mark’s introduction and designer are not documented.
assets.notes: A red maple leaf rising behind a waving flag (blue field, five red bands parted by white, a gold sun rising from its base) above “BC TRADE”.
assets.fidelityNote: Manually reconstructed vector, revised against the 196 × 218 pixel colour scan on 2026-11-14 and checked against the 1989 newspaper example. The leaf, varying flag separators, diagonal band and sun use deliberately authored curves; each letter is an independent outline. The open separations in T, R, A, D and E are represented as transparent gaps, as visible in both printed examples. A fixed-registration overlay review further corrects the flag folds, white separators and acute blue ends with local tangent-aligned caps. No automatic tracing or raster content. The exact typeface is not identified; small curves, gap widths and corner radii remain estimates at this scan resolution. Red #B22C20, blue #17447F and gold #EDC445 are approximate display colours, not an original specification. The unchanged 1991 scan remains available for comparison.
